title: C lollipop comments/macro names invert RFC 6550 §7.2 regions (behavior correct)
description: Comments say '0-127 linear restart; 128-255 circular', LOLLIPOP_CIRCULAR_BIT=128; RFC defines opposite (128+ linear, ≤127 circular). Code verified functionally correct (region-agnostic same-region branch; cross-region arithmetic matches RFC examples 240vs5, 250vs5; increment implements rule 2 exactly). Hazard: maintainer 'fixing' to match comments breaks interop. Rename LOLLIPOP_CIRCULAR_BIT→LOLLIPOP_LINEAR_BASE + correct comments; behavior untouched.
